gen-dafont-ozone-gf-abyssinica-sil: Ruler-straight and a bit technical, Ozone leads. Abyssinica SIL, a text serif, follows with arches that thin slightly off the stem, giving its tall-bodied words a soft, brushed warmth against the heading's hard line.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-cambo: Ozone draws every stem and crossbar at a single thickness, as if traced with a compass pencil, while its capitals barely rise above the lowercase. Cambo, a text serif, is the one that swings mellowly from thick to thin.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-fanwood-text: Ozone traces each letter with one line of constant weight, wide-set at every curve end. Fanwood Text, a text serif, handles the quieter work, with its large-eyed lowercase and hairlines a touch thinner.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-judson: Stencil-cut and stubborn, Ozone looks routed with a fixed-width bit. Judson's classic serif stems, thick enough to dwarf the fine hairlines beside them, and its brush-lifted curve ends make a sturdier, more handmade counterweight.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-naskh-arabic: Ozone gives its n arches the same thickness as the stems beside them, so capitals hardly stand apart from the lowercase. Noto Naskh Arabic, a text serif, adds a faint shimmer of changing weight.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-nastaliq-urdu: Dignified is the tone Noto Nastaliq Urdu brings, a classic serif with mild stress in its o and e and little ascender height. Ozone sits above it, unshaded and geometric, a line that never swells.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-rashi-hebrew: Noto Rashi Hebrew reads like lightly engraved brass, serif letters with short ascenders on tall lowercase bodies. And Ozone, with no stress tilting its round letters, earns its keep when big and brief.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-ahom: Ozone ends every terminal at the width it began, with wide-set curves throughout. Noto Serif Ahom, a classic serif, has a lofty lowercase and thick strokes only slightly heavier than thin; give Ozone the larger size.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-armenian: Authoritative is the mood Noto Serif Armenian carries, its big open counters and faint curve swell feeling approachable. Ozone, plain and unmodulated, earns its keep when it is big and short.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-balinese: Noto Serif Balinese reads with great vertical presence, sitting at a comfortable midpoint between flat strokes and dramatic ones. Ozone, showing no difference between its upright and sideways strokes, earns its keep when it is big and short.
